d: Thousands of migrants have gathered in southern Mexico, hoping to make their way towards the United States. For many, the Democratic victory in America’s 2026 midterm elections has revived hopes of a more welcoming immigration policy. But Donald Trump remains President, and his administration’s border crackdown is firmly in place. As an earlier migrant caravan disperses and a new group begins to form, Mexico finds itself under growing pressure from Washington.
